verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a media-conversion tool, so a conversion API with job status is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only a local CLI and C libraries (libav*) that can read network inputs; nothing documents an API that accepts an upload or URL, runs a tracked job with visible status, and returns the output file. The libraries are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented API takes an upload or URL, runs the conversion as a job with visible status, and returns the output file
